global-property.name: env
global-property.doc:name: Global Property
global-property.doc:description: Active environment: local by default; CloudHub passes env=cloud

configuration-properties.doc:name: Configuration properties
configuration-properties.doc:description: Environment properties: listener, provider endpoints and per-provider timeouts

configuration.doc:description: Global error handler: turns any error into the contract ErrorResponse

http:listener-config.name: sapi-price-providers-httpListenerConfig
http:listener-config.doc:name: HTTP Listener config
http:listener-config.doc:description: API HTTP listener. Host and port come from the environment properties

http:listener-connection.doc:description: Opens the environment HTTP port; on CloudHub the load balancer terminates TLS

http:request-config.name: provider-fak-http-config
http:request-config.doc:description: HTTP client for provider A (FAK, REST). Endpoint and timeout come from the properties

http:request-connection.doc:description: Connection to the provider A endpoint (WireMock locally, a tunnel on CloudHub)

http:request-config.name: provider-esc-http-config
http:request-config.doc:description: HTTP client for provider B (ESC, REST). Endpoint and timeout come from the properties

http:request-connection.doc:description: Connection to the provider B endpoint (WireMock locally, a tunnel on CloudHub)

wsc:config.name: provider-bor-wsc-config
wsc:config.doc:description: SOAP 1.1 client for provider C (BOR, OrderService). WSDL, address and timeout come from the properties

wsc:connection.doc:description: Uses the WSDL packaged in the app and sends requests to the configured address

error-handler.name: global-error-handler
error-handler.doc:name: Error Handler
error-handler.doc:description: Turns any error into the contract ErrorResponse with the matching HTTP status

logger.doc:description: Logs the error type, its description and the correlationId

ee:transform.doc:description: Resolves HTTP status, code, message and retryable flag from the error type
Builds the ErrorResponse, the HTTP status and the Retry-After header when the error is a 503
